description: This file defines utility types and functions for mocking and obtaining fetch implementations in a test environment, specifically for browser tests. It includes type guards and dynamic require cache busting for module dependencies.

methods.name: function isUsableFetch(value: unknown): value is FetchLike { isUsableFetch
methods.description: Type guard that determines if a given value is a fetch-like function that is usable, i.e., it is a function and does not have a 'mock' property.

methods.name: export function getBrowserTestFetch(): BrowserTestFetch { getBrowserTestFetch
methods.description: Function that dynamically requires the 'undici' module, attempts to bust its cache, and returns a fetch implementation either from 'undici' or the global scope, suitable for testing.

ctags.name: BrowserTestFetch
ctags.pattern: /^export type BrowserTestFetch = (input: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;$/

ctags.name: FetchLike
ctags.pattern: /^type FetchLike = ((input: string | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>) & {$/

ctags.name: fetch
ctags.pattern: /^  const { fetch } = require("undici") as typeof import("undici");$/

ctags.name: vitest
ctags.pattern: /^  const vitest = (globalThis as { vi?: { doUnmock?: (id: string) => void } }).vi;$/
